newsitem.title: USA: KN Energy on track to raise EPS 10-15 pct.
newsitem.headline: KN Energy on track to raise EPS 10-15 pct.

text.p: KN Energy Inc's chief executive officer said Tuesday the energy services company is on track to achieve earnings per share growth of 10 to 15 percent for the year.
Through the first half, the company's earnings per share were $0.09 ahead of 1996 at $0.99 versus $0.90.
KN's second quarter earnings of $0.34 per share -- versus $0.30 a year earlier -- were $0.01 behind the First Call consensus estimate of $0.35.
The latest First Call consensus earnings per share estimate for all of 1997 is $2.47 versus 1996's $2.14.

"It is important to note that several of KN's most significant activities -- the Bushton asset acquisition, the Pony Express Pipeline conversion, our expanded Douglas complex and Enable (a KN joint venture) -- will have positive effects this year, but the first full-year impact will come in 1998," CEO Larry Hall said in a press release accompanying the company's second quarter earnings.
